sentences.text:
This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice N S Sanjay Gowda
 Oral Judgment
1.
In respect of an accident which occurred on 10.06.2017 in which the claimant, a minor aged 13 years suffered grievous injuries, a claim petition was filed.

2. The Tribunal on assessment of the evidence has awarded a sum of Rs.1,50,000/- and it has proceeded to exonerate the liability on the insurer NC: 2024:KHC:50875 since the owner of the vehicle was plying the vehicle without a necessary permit.
3. As far as liability is concerned, since it is the case of the insurer that there was a breach of policy conditions.
In light of the judgment in Yallavva's case1, the insurer will have to pay the compensation and thereafter proceed to recover the same from the owner of the offending vehicle.

Consequently, the finding of the Tribunal in so far as liability is concerned, is modified, and, it is held that the insurer will have to pay the compensation and thereafter recover the same from the Poornesh M B vs Ashok P on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150022011/
2 owner of the offending vehicle.

4. As far as the compensation is concerned, this Court in MFA.No.426/2020 & connected cases disposed of on 27.09.2024 has laid down guidelines for payment New India Assurance Co. Ltd Vs.
Yallavva and Another - ILR 2020 KAR 2239 NC: 2024:KHC:50875 of compensation to a minor who has suffered disability in a motor vehicle accident.

sentences.text: 5. In this case, the evidence on record indicates that the claimant had suffered fracture of the femur.

Though the doctor was not examined, as there is a fracture to the major bone, it would be appropriate to treat the whole body disability at 15%.
6.

Since the accident was of the year 2017, as per Table - 1 in the aforesaid judgment2, the claimant would be entitled to Rs.5,06,868/- (Rs.1,87,729/- X 18 multiplier X 15% disability) towards pecuniary loss.
7. In respect of non-pecuniary loss, as per Table - 2 of the aforesaid judgment3, the claimant would be entitled to Rs.3,63,463/-.

The claimant would also 2 Inflation rate For disability Year below 20%
2017 2.49 1,87,729 3 Inflation Above 10% Year rate upto 30% disability 2017 2.49 3,63,463 NC:
2024:KHC:50875 entitled for a sum of Rs.75,265/- towards medical expenses.
Thus, in all, the claimant would be entitled to Rs.9,45,596/- along with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realisation.
8. The insurer shall deposit the said amount within a period of two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.

9. On such deposit being made, the same shall be kept in fixed deposit for a period of ten years in any Nationalised Bank and the claimant would be entitled to withdraw accrued interest periodically,
either by himself or through his parents.
10.
This appeal is accordingly allowed in part.
